title: ClaimNPC
description: ClaimNPC is a lightweight and configurable Minecraft plugin that allows players to purchase claim blocks through NPCs using in-game money.
body:
**ClaimNPC**

ClaimNPC is a lightweight and configurable Minecraft plugin that lets players buy claim blocks via NPCs using in-game money. It integrates seamlessly with EssentialsX, Vault, and GriefPrevention to provide a smooth, professional land-claim experience.

Players interact with villager NPCs to purchase claim blocks, with options for Small, Medium, and Large packages — all fully customizable in terms of price, block amounts, and NPC name.

**Features**

**NPC Claim Shop** – Players buy claim blocks by clicking NPCs

**Economy Support** – Works with Vault and EssentialsX

**GriefPrevention** Integration – Blocks automatically added to player claims

**Fully Configurable** – Customize amounts, prices, and NPC names

**Multiple Claim Packages** – Small, Medium, and Large bundles

**Data Management** – NPC IDs and data stored in data.yml

**Commands**

/claimnpc spawn – Spawn a new claim NPC

/claimnpc rename – Rename an existing NPC

/claimnpc remove – Remove an NPC using its ID

/claimnpc reload – Reload plugin configuration

**Configuration**

All NPC data is stored in data.yml, where you can easily customize:

**NPC Names**

**Claim Block Amounts**

**Prices**

**NPC IDs**

**_Ideal For_**

SMP Servers

Survival Servers

Economy-based Servers

Servers using GriefPrevention Claims
